# HubSpot Field Notes

> Step-by-step HubSpot fixes, how-tos, and gotchas by Sam Barth, a HubSpot-certified practitioner. Each article lists the subscription tier and permissions required and the date the steps were last verified in a live HubSpot portal. Independent resource, not an official HubSpot publication.

- Link builder for direct links into any HubSpot portal: https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/link-builder.html
- Request a fix: https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/request-a-fix.html

## Commerce Hub

- [HubSpot quotes: statuses, approvals, and who still has legacy quotes](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/hubspot-quotes-basics/): How to read quote statuses in HubSpot, where to turn on quote approvals, and the September 2025 legacy quote access rules. (Requires Varies: legacy quotes with Sales Hub; newer quote features with Revenue Hub; verified 2026-10-07)
- [HubSpot payment links: sell a product without a quote](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/payment-links/): What HubSpot payment links are, the HubSpot payments versus Stripe choice, testing in a sandbox, and attaching a payment link to a form. (Requires HubSpot payments needs Starter or above; Stripe processing works on all subscriptions; verified 2026-10-07)
- [One product, several prices: tiered pricing in the HubSpot product library](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/tiered-product-pricing/): Where HubSpot's tiered pricing methods (volume-based, graduated and stair-step) live, what subscription and seat they need, and what you see without them. (Requires Revenue Hub subscription and seat for tiered pricing; verified 2026-10-07)
- [Sync Stripe data into HubSpot: what syncs and which way](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/stripe-data-sync/): Which Stripe objects HubSpot's Stripe sync brings in (customers, invoices, products, subscriptions), the sync direction for each, and how it differs from Stripe payment processing. (Requires Check your subscription for Stripe sync; verified 2026-10-07)
- [QuickBooks Online and HubSpot invoices: what syncs and what is blocked](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/quickbooks-online-invoices/): How the QuickBooks Online data sync handles HubSpot invoices, the filter check, sync failures, and why invoice-level taxes and fees are blocked. (Requires Check your subscription for invoices; verified 2026-10-07)
- [Copy line items to another deal: how cloning works](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/copy-line-items/): How HubSpot clones line items between deals, quotes and invoices, why there is no ongoing sync, and the options for reusing a deal's products. (Requires All tiers with products; verified 2026-10-07)
- [Shopify data sync: what comes over and what doesn't](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/shopify-integration/): What HubSpot's Shopify data sync app syncs, the limits on orders, variants and companies, and the tracking code it installs. - [Take payment when someone books a meeting](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/paid-meetings/): How the Collect payments switch adds a payment link to a HubSpot scheduling page, and what has to be set up first. (Requires Needs HubSpot payments or Stripe set up; verified 2026-10-07)
- [Start a workflow when a payment succeeds or fails](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/payment-workflow-trigger/): How payment-based workflows use the Payments object, Status and Source properties, with HubSpot's welcome-email and failed-payment examples. - [Discount codes on payment links](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/payment-link-discounts/): How HubSpot discount codes work at payment link checkout, where they can't be used, and who can create them. (Requires Needs HubSpot payments or Stripe; verified 2026-10-07)
- [Let buyers choose a quantity on a payment link](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/payment-link-quantity/): How HubSpot payment links let customers edit line item quantity with minimum and maximum limits, and the one-time-use setting. - [Sync invoices with Xero](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/xero-integration/): How HubSpot's Xero data sync handles invoices in each direction, the card fee caveat, and when custom mappings need Data Hub. (Requires Data Hub Starter for custom mappings; verified 2026-10-07)
- [Credit memos, voids and refunds on HubSpot invoices](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/invoice-credit-notes/): How HubSpot credit memos apply to invoices, why invoices with payments can't be voided, and what blocks deleting an invoice.
